description: Fetch Wikipedia and other Wikimedia project article URLs for a Wikidata item. A sitelink maps a site code (e.g., "enwiki", "commonswiki") to an article title and URL. Major items can have 300+ sitelinks across languages. Use sites to filter to specific site codes, or wikis_only to return only Wikipedia editions. Only Q-IDs (items) have sitelinks — properties (P-IDs) do not.

id.description: Q-ID of the item (e.g., "Q76"), bare or as an entity URI or wd: form (e.g., "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q76", "wd:Q76"). Only items have sitelinks; properties (P-IDs) are not supported.

sites.description: Optional filter to specific site codes (e.g., ["enwiki", "frwiki", "commonswiki"]), matched in any case with surrounding whitespace ignored. Omit to return all sitelinks.

wikis_only.description: When true, return only Wikipedia language editions: sitelinks whose URL is on a <subdomain>.wikipedia.org host, such as enwiki (en.wikipedia.org) or be_x_oldwiki (be-tarask.wikipedia.org). Excludes Abstract Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, Wikispecies, Wikisource, Wiktionary, Wikiquote, and every other project.

name: wikidata_get_sitelinks

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `entity_not_found`: No item exists at this Q-ID — either unassigned or out of range. `not_an_item`: A P-ID was supplied — only items (Q-IDs) have sitelinks. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

id.description: The resolved Q-ID whose sitelinks were fetched.

message.description: Informational note when a requested site code is absent or no sitelinks match.

notFound.description: Requested site codes absent from the resolved item, normalized to lowercase with surrounding whitespace removed.

redirectedFrom.description: The normalized requested Q-ID when it redirects to id.

url.description: Full URL to the article. Omitted when unavailable.

sitelinks.description: Map of site code to sitelink metadata. Empty when the entity has no matching sitelinks.

title: Get Wikidata Sitelinks
